item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - 1989 (Taylor's Version) Dolby Atmos - Original Masters
item.description:
Hi there!
There was a version of 1989 (Taylor's Version) Dolby Atmos that was released on the original release date, about a month after, the masters were swapped for the ones we have now. Would anyone happen to have the original masters from this album, preferably the deluxe version, if possible. Thanks!
